look.title: Pictures to approve
look.about: Each card is a family of pictures: the new one beside the old where there is one, at the size the game draws it. Under it is what its acceptance spec measured.

accept.label: Accept
accept.means: The look is right and the spec agrees.
accept.then: The pictures are kept, and your decision is recorded.

look.label: Redo
look.then: The pictures go back to be made again; the spec's bounds stay as they are.

number.label: Move the bound
number.means: The look is right, and a bound that failed it is wrong.
number.then: That bound moves to the measured value, recorded as yours.

effect.title: Visual effects to approve
effect.about: Each card shows one visual effect moving, filmed over a neutral grey. The emitter circles so a trail is seen as it would follow a ship. Decide whether it looks right for the game.

legend.reach: how far a particle travels, in metres
legend.alive: particles or ribbon points at once: its budget

effect.against: . On the left, how it looks in the game today; on the right, what was built from the declaration. The two should match.

accept.label: Accept
accept.then: The game plays exactly the effect that was built, and your decision is recorded.

look.label: Redo
look.means: The effect does not look right.
look.then: Say what is different; the declaration goes back to be changed, and the effect comes back in a new sitting.

line.title: Lines to approve
line.about: Each card is a line of the game's world in each language, with what the words check found in it.

accept.label: Accept
accept.means: The line sounds like the world.
accept.then: It joins the lines canon, which later lines are held to.

look.label: Reject
look.means: It does not sound like the world.
look.then: Say why; it stays out of the canon.

sound.title: Sounds to approve
sound.about: Each card plays the new sound beside the old one where there is one; a loop plays over and over so its seam is heard. Under it is what was measured.

accept.label: Accept
accept.then: The new sound replaces the old one in the game.

look.label: Redo
look.then: Say why; the sound goes back to be made again.
